summary: Rosewood Hotel Group has appointed Sam Cooper as Vice President, Wellness, Global, based in New York, after leading wellness across 38 Discovery Land Company properties and earlier roles at Canyon Ranch. Gaye Gibson, formerly head of global retail at Maybourne, becomes Vice President, Retail and Partnerships, Global, in Hong Kong. Both report to COO Anthony Ingham.
title: Rosewood names global vice presidents for wellness and retail
